'''Takobo City'''<ref name="Concept">{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/the-future-of-the-force-concept-art-gallery|text="The Future of the Force" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|slide 6}}</ref> was the [[capital]] [[city]] of [[Takobo]]. During the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] an [[Ithorian]] populated area known as [[Hammertown]] was located in the city.<ref name="Takobo" /> In [[3 BBY]],<ref name="Timeline">{{RebelsDate|210}}</ref> the [[Spectres]] and their companion, [[Ahsoka Tano]], [[Duel in Hammertown|dueled]] the [[Inquisitorius|Inquisitors]] known as the [[Fifth Brother]] and the [[Seventh Sister]] in Takobo City.<ref name="The Future of the Force">{{Rebels|The Future of the Force}}</ref>

{{City-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Takobo City first appeared in "[[The Future of the Force]]", an episode of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''.<ref name="The Future of the Force" />
